ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The image shows the stages of the life cycle of a frog, and uses the letters A, B, C, D, E, F to label them. A is labeled beside a cluster of small eggs; B, C, D are labeled beside tadpoles or developing tadpoles of different forms; E is labeled beside a young frog that has already grown four limbs but still has an obvious tail; F is labeled beside a larger adult frog on the left side, with complete four limbs and no tail. Then reason: The question asks which letter represents a mature frog. A mature frog should be a fully developed adult form, with complete four limbs and no tail. The one in the image that fits this feature is F.
